description: This file defines the QueryFilter class, which is used in category and search functionalities to filter display based on entities such as Manufacturer. It contains properties for filter code, filter id, and filter type, with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: QueryFilter
classes.description: Represents filtering criteria for categories and search functionalities, based on entity code, id, or type.

methods.name: getFilterCode
methods.description: Returns the filter code used for filtering on an entity property.

methods.name: setFilterCode
methods.description: Sets the filter code used for filtering.

methods.name: getFilterId
methods.description: Returns the filter ID used for filtering.

methods.name: setFilterId
methods.description: Sets the filter ID used for filtering.

methods.name: getFilterType
methods.description: Returns the filter type indicating the filtering criterion.

methods.name: setFilterType
methods.description: Sets the filter type indicating the filtering criterion.
